subject: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@orbitspark.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance

Hi Sergio / Lauren / Kimberly,

Thanks again for chatting earlier this week — we appreciate Redwood's openness on private deployments. OrbitSpark is ready to move our connector through your partner validation workflow and want to confirm the scope for the "safety sandpit" run you mentioned (limited test harness against private-preview).

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm which Redwood test vectors you want us to run (LLM request shapes, rate/latency targets)?
- We'll need a short list of security artifacts (SOC2 cert, data handling checklist) to attach to the intake.
- We can provide a sandbox tenant and service account; attaching the integration spec (stub) and a short test script.

Attachments: orbitspark_integration_spec_v1.pdf (stub)

Timeline: OrbitSpark can provision the sandbox by next Tue (Apr 3) if that works for your validation team.

Cheers,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
OrbitSpark

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@orbitspark.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance

Samir — great, thanks for the spec. Welcome aboard.

High-level plan from Redwood (proposed):
1) Intake & artifacts (this week) — security checklist, API key rotation policy, minimal test data handling docs.
2) Sandbox provisioning & smoke (Apr 3–4) — Redwood validation team will run the safety sandpit harness focused on prompt prefix caching, tokenization compatibility, and failure-mode fallbacks.
3) Acceptance run (Apr 5–6) — full run of our partner validation suite.
4) Conditional technical acceptance + pilot onboarding (Apr 9) — limited customer-facing pilot if pass.

Owners:
- Intake & security artifacts: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.ai)
- Validation harness & execution: Sergio Alvarez (sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai)
- Pilot ops / provisioning: Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwood.ai)

To keep things tight, please upload the SOC2 summary and data classification doc to the Drive link I created (shared below). I've attached the Redwood validation template for your team to populate — it lists the exact vectors we run.

Attachments: redwood_validation_template.xlsx
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDE-orbit-spark-sandbox

If you can confirm sandbox credentials and an SSO test account by EOD Monday, we'll lock the Apr 3 smoke window.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@orbitspark.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@orbitspark.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance

Hi Sergio — attaching the items you requested.

What we uploaded:
- OrbitSpark_Redwood_NDA_signed.pdf (signed copy) — also sending via DocuSign link.
- SOC2-summary.txt (high-level controls and auditor contact).
- orbitspark_sso_test_creds.txt (service account + ephemeral test creds for sandbox).
- We populated the redwood_validation_template.xlsx and put it in the Drive folder.

Sandbox access: https://app.redwood.ai/partner/sandbox/OS-2028-042 (service account: os-test@orbitspark.com, key TTL 24h)
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/NEED-EXAMPLE

Notes on the connector behavior:
- We perform client-side prefix compression to reduce token costs; compatible with known Llama-like tokenizers but we included a checksum table.
- Fallback behavior: if KV cache misses over 3s, connector will retry with a reduced batch size; we document this in the template.

Let us know if you need any additional telemetry or logs from our side during the validation run.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Integrations
OrbitSpark

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@orbitspark.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@orbitspark.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance

Forwarding Samir/Alyssa's uploads and confirming internal scheduling.

Internal checklist items (owner in parentheses):
- Confirm SOC2 summary & redaction (Kimberly)
- Provision sandbox creds and verify ingress rules (Lauren) — target Apr 3 09:00 PDT smoke
- Run Redwood partner validation harness (Sergio) — smoke then full suite Apr 5–6
- Capture regression metrics (latency p95, tokens per call, cache hit rate) and post to shared Drive (Sergio)
- Legal/marketplace paperwork wrap (we'll reference the signed NDA) (Sales Ops)

Kimberly — can you confirm the SOC doc is acceptable for intake? If yes, I'll move the smoke to the calendar invite and loop Customer Success for the pilot readiness checklist.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@orbitspark.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@orbitspark.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitSpark connector: safety sandpit validation & acceptance

All — reviewed the SOC2 summary and the populated validation template. A couple of notes before we call this "technically accepted":

- SOC2 summary: adequate for partner intake (controls map to our checklist). No additional audit artifacts required for sandbox.
- Tokenization checksum table looks good; we'll monitor token anomalies during the run.
- We need one minor change to the connector's retry backoff (make jitter randomized 250–750ms) — Alyssa, can your eng team push that small change to the sandbox build this week?

Assuming the backoff tweak is applied and the smoke pass on Apr 3 shows stable p95 < 250ms and cache hit > 60%, we'll mark the connector as conditionally accepted and move to a limited pilot (region: us-west) starting Apr 9. Legal/PS paperwork can proceed in parallel (use deal_id OS-2028-042).

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance (Partner Intake)
Redwood Inference
